question: What internet stipend do remote employees get?
queries: What internet stipend do remote employees get?
remote work internet stipend per month

results.title: Remote and Hybrid Work Policy
results.heading: Internet stipend
results.text: Employees in approved fully remote roles receive an internet stipend of $50 per month, paid through payroll.

results.title: Remote and Hybrid Work Policy
results.heading: Eligibility
results.text: A role may be fully remote only with written approval from the employee's director and HR.

results.title: Remote and Hybrid Work Policy
results.heading: Security while remote
results.text: When working outside the office, employees must follow the IT Security Policy, including the VPN rule for public Wi-Fi.

results.title: Remote and Hybrid Work Policy
results.heading: Working abroad
results.text: Employees may work from a country other than their country of employment for up to 30 days in a calendar year, with prior approval from HR.

results.title: Remote and Hybrid Work Policy
results.heading: Core hours
results.text: All employees must be available between 10:00 and 15:00 in their local time zone on working days.
